# Initialization script for system monitoring environment
# This script sets up the necessary tools for memory monitoring

echo "Initializing system monitoring environment..."

# Ensure procps is installed (provides free command)
if ! command -v free &> /dev/null; then
    apt-get update -qq > /dev/null 2>&1
    apt-get install -y -qq procps > /dev/null 2>&1
fi

# Verify the environment
if command -v free &> /dev/null; then
    echo "System monitoring environment initialized successfully"
    echo "Available tools: free, awk"
else

fi
EOF

args.script:
cat > /app/calculate_memory_usage.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Calculate the percentage of used memory (integer value)
# This script reads system memory information and calculates usage percentage

# Run initialization first
/app/init_monitoring.sh

# Get total memory and used memory from free command
# Using -m flag to get values in megabytes for easier calculation
TOTAL_MEM=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $2}')
USED_MEM=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/ {print $3}')

# Calculate percentage: (used / total) * 100
# Using integer arithmetic
PERCENTAGE=$((USED_MEM * 100 / TOTAL_MEM))

echo "$PERCENTAGE"
EOF
